subject: Hygienic seal leak during repeated 132°C CIP exposure
symptoms: Minor leakage after repeated hot CIP cycles.
diagnosis: Continuous / repeated exposure exceeded the 125°C standard hygienic EPDM guidance.
resolution: Changed to hygienic FKM seal and updated maintenance plan.
service_lesson: Use hygienic FKM for HX-520 continuous or repeated duty above 125°C.
